publication_scope: Static analysis of the supplied watchOS 6.3.1 kernelcache and DeviceTree for an emulation boot: an instruction census (PAC and Apple IMPDEF system registers) and the platform MMIO map. No Apple firmware, kernelcache bytes or DeviceTree bytes are published; only counts and the public device addresses.

sources.kernelcache.release.watch5 (from the OTA: pac-and-register-census.txt is the output of tools/opwwe231/watchos/port/pac_census.py (Capstone skipdata) over the code segments.
sources.DeviceTree.n146bap.im4p (plaintext): t8006-platform-device-map.txt is decoded from device-tree/arm-io node reg properties.

excluded_by_policy: the dyld shared cache and rootfs
